title: Bounded continuous satin paths: independent geometry and machine validation

methodology.scope: 32 byte-identical preceding-release fixtures plus20 bounded controls:16 closed ellipse/stadium/irregular curves at declared phases/pitches and4 equivalent-region cohorts. All source hashes and new20 SVG texts are included. No raster attachments are embedded.
methodology.source_snapshots: main dc8081d and previous dfdd476 are immutable git archives. Geometry-only and geometry+jump stages isolate root fixes. Final working-tree Python files+pyproject match the immutable36-file2f4fe654 bundle, also verified against the running sources after all validation.
methodology.main_provenance: The28 unchanged-case main reports copied under main-inherited come from the prior matched dc8081d archive. They use the same source bytes, parameters and common quality.py: the dfdd476 quality.py SHA equals the preceding evaluator. Other24 main controls were generated afresh. All old per-colour footprint metrics were reconstructed from machine command windows and matched17 fields exactly before counter augmentation.
methodology.final_provenance: 52 final balanced cases were generated as candidate-initial on the exact final code; no core edit followed. The final source copy is a verified alias, not a later unmeasured candidate.
methodology.physical_settings: Native canvas80x70mm, real raster logos80mm, fit_to_hoop=True. Paired PNG widths preserve24px/mm source artwork physical scale instead of forcing each crop to80mm. stable/40wt/cutaway/BrotherSkitchPP1/100x100mm hoop/max_colors6. Original32 density100%; controlled closed curves set density_percent=None and actual satin spacing0.4/0.5mm, asserted against effective parameters.
methodology.common_geometry: Frozen dfdd476 quality.py on actual captured quantized top blocks, nominal thread0.3mm, raster305dpi and structural distance tolerance0.25mm. Includes combined, per-colour and component bbox+1mm audits; nearby same-colour stitching can contribute to component metrics. Support/locks/travel are excluded. This model is not textile sew-out.
methodology.continuity: Extraction hooks are read-only and used only for quality. Legacy80degree cuts create5 raw satin rails/blocks from one closed MAT cycle with no watershed. Optional complete rails are separate proposals; acceptance is judged on actual output blocks and declared fidelity tolerances, not only raw rail count.
methodology.seam: Independent on every captured logical closed satin block, even without exact endpoint repetition: drop only one exact terminal closure, retain other head/tail nodes, cyclic lag2/4/6/8 with minimum_stitch minus0.050001mm. Reports wrap distances, geometric repeats and actual top STITCH cycles/unique coordinates, excluding command-window context and locks. Selfchecks detected a non-terminal seam duplicate missed by an endpoint-only assumption.
methodology.holes: Negative space per colour with8-connected source background. Deep source counter core eroded0.4mm allows0.15mm stable compensation, nominal0.3mm thread and0.1mm rounding. Only actual common top footprints are measured. Empty eroded cores are unmeasurable; underlay and physical thread pull are not simulated.
methodology.machine: PES/DST decoded and compared with quantized stitch coordinates and colour changes; PES colours exact.100mm hoop, configured8mm stitch bound and12.0001mm software jump bound. Actual max float measured separately. Exports do not prove manufacturer/fabric acceptance.
methodology.performance: Three source snapshots sequentially; fresh process per case/source, imports outside timing, one warm-up discarded then five full generate() calls with compare_strategies=False. Includes input, planning, preview and PES/DST files. Six pairs of machine byte hashes verify repeatability. Supplemental decoding/geometry/seam audits and4KiB streaming hashes are outside timers.
methodology.memory: macOS ru_maxrss is bytes. Process high-water RSS immediately after each generate(), maximum across6 runs, includes imports/warm-up/caches/retained allocation. Subsequent audits excluded; tiny preceding streamed hash buffers may enter later high-water marks. This is RSS, not algorithm-only allocations.
methodology.timing_limits: Root tests/build/browser QA had finished before timing; no concurrent agent generation/test jobs. Shared local development Mac, OS/background load uncontrolled. Five-repeat sample p95 is descriptive; no causal speedup or service-level claim.
methodology.prior_pitch_mistake: An initial local diagnostic used density100 and therefore measured0.4mm despite requested0.5mm. Those artifacts are preserved under pitch-overridden-before-audit but excluded here; only corrected effective-pitch-asserted reports enter the comparisons.

public_example.note: Same paired-ellipse geometry and paint as UI demonstration; public sample groups inherited stroke attributes and whitespace differently, so its source hash differs. UI machine download had841 sewn points.

summary.jump_fix: Two translated-stadium prefix chains formerly jumped[0,0]→[-120,7], norm12.020399mm. Auditing rounded interpolation adds a segment; maxjump8.0156mm. All52 actual STITCH coordinate sequences were independently compared and unchanged by geometry+jump stage.
summary.geometry_fix: Three real-logo MAT path counts change (Pepsi10→13, Falcon5→6, Nike9→11), but all52 eventual machine outputs are unchanged by the graph condition alone.

limits.scope: No photos/textile sweeps or real sewn samples in this lot. Logos remain their prior balanced mix of qualified satin and fill.
limits.coverage: Some promoted shapes lose a small amount of literal model coverage, bounded by0.005. Fewer starts/connections are the improvement; structural100% is not literal100% coverage.
limits.coherence: All corresponding regions retain their common stitch method/density/underlay policy. Reflected source copies need not have identical machine coordinates or temporal order.
limits.fallbacks: Native ring/fine-ring, ellipse-column-shift-p50, stadium-column-shift-p40 and paired rings retain validated legacy rails when the cyclic proposal does not meet the guards. Wide outlines and true junctions retain their necessary splitting.
limits.preexisting: Tiny omitted details in Nike native SVG and multicolour PNG remain; small structural gaps in real logos remain below the existing geometric review thresholds. This is not a universal zero-defect guarantee.

reproduction.policy: Same harness/source root, --label final --policy satin (then fill) --names ellipse-column-zero-p40-svg s-curve-svg ring-svg paired-ellipses-svg dominant-fill-round-r2-svg
reproduction.performance: .venv/bin/python output/engine-consolidation/continuous-satin/independent/benchmark.py --source-root output/engine-consolidation/continuous-satin/independent/source-final/src --label perf-final --policy balanced --mode performance --repeats 5 --names ring-svg fine-ring-svg s-curve-svg ellipse-column-zero-p40-svg stadium-column-zero-p40-svg phoenix-bitmap nike-lettering-bitmap multicolor-svg
reproduction.baselines: Same command/protocol with source-main/perf-main and source-previous/perf-previous, measured sequentially; code archived by full refs listed above, not mutable checkout.
reproduction.prior_report: docs/benchmarks/auto-satin-fidelity-2026-10-13.json for original32 fixtures and inherited v0.6.3 classification changes; do not attribute those older gains to the new continuity patch.
reproduction.public_repro: The20 inline generated SVG files and their physical settings can be recreated without private inputs. The4 original raster-logo attachments remain local, identified only by SHA/basename.

material_controls_annex.method: Independent reviewer8 cases, current final code with promotion disabled versus enabled; a within-snapshot comparison, distinct from main/dfdd baselines. All32 legacy/final PES/DST readbacks match. Single-run times omitted; no fabric sew-out claim.
